identity.name: E1_Anti_AI_Trading
principles: Fusion: Bloomberg Terminal meets Swiss Poster
Content: Data is the hero, UI is the frame
Contrast: Stark blacks vs. Neon signals

mono.usage: Prices, Token Balances, Hash IDs, Order Book Data

rules: NEVER use purple/teal gradients for backgrounds.
Backgrounds must be solid dark (#09090b) or very subtle noise. No large gradients.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (p-6, p-8) for containers, Tight (p-2, gap-1) for data tables.
layout.container_style: Border-only (1px solid border-white/10), No Shadow, Sharp or sm-rounded corners.

buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-sm

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md for sticky headers and overlays.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture overlay to the main background if possible.

sections.name: Order Book
sections.style: Dense table, red/green text, mono font

images.description: Abstract dark geometric cylinders - Use for Login/Landing Hero
B&W Professional Portrait - Use for User Profile

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'ArrowUpRight' for profit, 'ArrowDownRight' for loss.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add '@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans' and '@fontsource/jetbrains-mono' to package.json immediately.
2. DARK MODE DEFAULT: Ensure the app defaults to dark mode. Add 'dark' class to the html or body tag by default.
3. NO GRADIENT TEXT: Do not use gradient text for headings. Keep it stark white.
4. DATA DENSITY: In the Order Book and History, reduce cell padding (py-2) to show more data.
5. USE SONNER: Replace any 'alert()' calls with 'toast()' from 'sonner'.
6. MOCK DATA: Generate realistic mock data for the order book (spread of prices) to make the UI look populated.
7. CHARTS: Use 'recharts' for the price chart. Style it minimal: hide grid lines, use a single accent color stroke.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts.
Micro-interactions: Add hover:bg-white/5 to all table rows and list items.
Accessibility: Ensure green/red text has enough contrast against the dark background.
